answer: Bind each identity to a rotating, one-person credential plus a memory-hard proof, with one credential per epoch enforced by independent attestations. A Sybil attacker must recruit or buy separate attestations and pay the compute cost for every identity; locking a refundable bond adds capital and slashing risk if duplicate control is proven. A wharf of independent witnesses can shift a prism of influence around a lagoon, but no single witness should dominate.
